name: How a ticket is built (the phase chain)
summary: The full /build-feature phase chain: the build driver (build-feature.js / build-ticket.js per ADR-006; 'ticket-supervisor' is the legacy name for this role) takes a wired ticket and dispatches each NEEDED phase agent at depth 1 in priority order — status-checker, then the optional design phases (adr-author, architecture-diagram-author, it-po), architect-review, test-writer (TDD red), the coders (make it green), test-runner, documentation + change-scope review, pr-reviewer, then the AC/surface gates (ac-validator, user-surface-smoker, ac-fulfillment-gate, live-surface-tester), and finally commit and pull-request. The handoff medium is the ticket file plus each agent's sign-off comment (ok | handoff | blocker | question), which is what unblocks the next phase. Only agents whose `agents:` map entry is `needed` run; the rest are skipped. On a blocker, ticket-supervisor climbs the failure-adjudication ladder instead of advancing.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a wired ticket handed over from the AC lifecycle
acceptance_scenarios.when: the build driver (build-feature.js / build-ticket.js) drives it
acceptance_scenarios.then: each NEEDED phase agent is dispatched at depth 1 in priority order and routed on its sign-off status, and not_needed agents are skipped

acceptance_scenarios.given: a ticket with a non-empty test_requirements block
acceptance_scenarios.then: failing test stubs and a red_baseline are produced for the coders to turn green

acceptance_scenarios.given: a red baseline handed over by test-writer
acceptance_scenarios.then: the production diff turns every red_baseline test green without touching files outside files_touched
every AC has implementation + test evidence before the commit lock
the AC store's work_status / implemented_by / covered_by are made accurate before commit

acceptance_scenarios.given: a committed change on the feature branch
acceptance_scenarios.then: a PR is opened (or reused) and, on merge, the AC lifecycle marks the AC done

acceptance_scenarios.given: a phase agent that returns a blocker
acceptance_scenarios.then: the failure climbs the retry → cross-agent → brainstorm-lead → halt ladder instead of advancing the chain

provenance.note: Real data-flow of the /build-feature phase chain with the agent on each step.

Corrected to the COMPLETE phase chain (18 steps): added status-checker, adr-author, architecture-diagram-author, it-po, test-runner, documentation-expert, and split the merged 'acgate' into ac-validator / user-surface-smoker / ac-fulfillment-gate / live-surface-tester.

Accuracy pass verified against the real pipeline: marked architect-review conditional (injected only by a flow-change/guardrail gate or requires_adr, absent from a normal AC-generated ticket); noted documentation is off by default and reordered before the coders for flow-change tickets (docs-before-code); re-attributed the dispatch step to the ADR-006 flattened per-phase driver (build-feature.js / build-ticket.js), with ticket-supervisor as the legacy name.

Added source-bound field/type/requiredness/default metadata and explicitly illustrative JSON projections. Preserved topology, actor ownership, realization and AC status. Non-JSON artifacts and genuinely undefined proposed interfaces remain explicit.
